## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat(server): …`, `fix: …`)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix includes a test that fails without it)
- [ ] Docs, CLI help and CHANGELOG are updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] No real sessions, telemetry, credentials or personal data were added
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies
